notes: Low-cost urgent care for cats and dogs whose owners live in New York City and have a household income under $50,000, for a qualifying medical problem. 424 East 92nd Street (between 1st and York Avenues), Manhattan. By appointment only, Monday to Friday; no walk-ins, closed on major holidays. Not free: bring an EBT card, SSI award letter, VA benefits letter, proof of unemployment or workers' compensation, or proof of TANF to apply for help with the cost. It does not do check-ups, vaccines or routine dental care. For a medical emergency, go to an emergency hospital.
